source.title: A few open problems on characteristic classes of foliations

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6843307 for document identifier 6843307. The zbMATH API identifies the exact work as 'A few open problems on characteristic classes of foliations' by Shigeyuki Morita, published in Advanced Studies in Pure Mathematics 72, pages 221-237, with Zbl identifier 1391.58007. Local workflow shard metadata, Crossref, and OpenAlex identify the matching DOI as 10.2969/aspm/07210221.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. Direct shell fetches of the zbMATH public resolver returned HTTP 403, while the zbMATH API, Crossref, OpenAlex, and local shard rows exposed only identity metadata. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, no best open-access location, and no repository full text for the DOI.

Identifier-specific and bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier, exact title, first author, DOI, Crossref primary Project Euclid URL, OpenAlex record, and Project Euclid download patterns. Exact-title and DOI searches surfaced only the ETH table-of-contents PDF, citation/reference pages, Crossref/OpenAlex/zbMATH metadata, unrelated works, or Project Euclid routes that were inaccessible or challenged; no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, Crossref metadata, OpenAlex metadata, table-of-contents pages, citation pages, search snippets, or related papers.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-6843307.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
